title: Imperative Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 📜️imperative plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/**) from its 8-crate constitutional layout (1 manifest/artifact bundle + 1 app crate + 6 module crates: engine, pack, protocol, op, ui, dsl) plus 5 extension crates (control, text, logic, math, core) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-imperative` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy tree (🗿️artifacts/🔺️diff/🗣️dsl/🎒️pack/🔧️op/📡️spr/⚙️engine, 🎛️apps/.../🎭️modes/.../🪟️windows/..., 🎮️commands, 📌️panels), per master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE and its TEMPLATE.md recipe. Preserve every [package.metadata.*] table verbatim. 🧩️extensions/* stay untouched (Rust-crate merge only). Do NOT touch root Cargo.toml, root script.ts, registry script, launch.json, any other plugin, or AGENTS.md anywhere. Do NOT touch ✏️s/🔨️modules/📜️imperative/ (different, unrelated s-module kernel crate with the same name).
summary: Migrated the 📜️imperative plugin's 8-crate constitutional layout (manifest/artifact bundle + app facade + engine/pack/protocol/op/ui/dsl module crates) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-imperative` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/📦️packages/🦀️rust/, with the full taxonomy tree (🗿️artifacts/📜️imperative/{🔺️diff,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,📡️spr,⚙️engine}, 🎛️apps/📜️imperative/{🎮️commands/{🔧️step,👁️view},🎭️modes/✏️edit/🪟️windows/{📋️main,📝️script},📌️panels/{📄️document,🛍️catalogue,🔍️inspection}}). Old ImperativeCommand (hand-rolled #[derive(dsl::DslOps)] enum) was rebuilt via app_commands! into 11 typed payload structs across 2 command-group files; added Serialize/Deserialize to the plugin-owned ValueDsl type to satisfy the macro's forced derive (no framework change needed). Split the old op crate's single file across 🔺️diff (OperationDiff/ImperativeDiff), 🔧️op (Operation/backwards), and 📡️spr (OpText/OpBinary via the DSL mirror enum) per the taxonomy's constitutional-role mapping. ImperativeConfig+ImperativeConfigOperation moved from the old engine crate to app-level 🦀️config.rs. Fixed the systemic broken-`Ok(`-missing-paren corruption (TEMPLATE §12.3) in the old ui crate's handle() match arms as a natural side effect of porting into per-command handler functions. All [package.metadata.*] tables (component, semio, playground, wasm-pack profiles) preserved verbatim. Extensions (🧩️extensions/control,text,logic,math,core) and the s-module kernel crate at ✏️s/🔨️modules/📜️imperative/ (a different, legitimate dependency — confirmed via Cargo.toml + code reading, never confused with the plugin) were left completely untouched. Verification: cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2) clean, clippy -D warnings clean, 80/80 tests pass (baseline was 67 across the old crates, expanded via richer command-surface/manifest-sanity tests matching the flow pilot's pattern), full wire-format byte-diff proof for all 11 ImperativeCommand variants (byte-identical before/after, captured via temporary [DEBUG] dump tests on both old and new crates, saved to 🧪️wire-baseline-before.txt), wasm32-wasip2 build produced a real .wasm artifact. Old 8 crate manifests deleted only after all of the above passed. Fixed the one cross-cutting dependent found (dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep: repointed its `imperative` dep from the old app-facade crate to the new plugin crate, and its `use imperative::ImperativeDocument` to `use imperative::artifacts::imperative::ImperativeDocument`) — confirmed via full repo-wide Cargo.toml + use-line grep that this was the only one. Did NOT touch root Cargo.toml/script.ts, registry script, launch.json, any other plugin, or any AGENTS.md — registrar handoff (exact root Cargo.toml lines to remove/add) is in the final report.
